ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends Customer's access but says nothing about getting our data back or help migrating, so we have added a standard exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards. If six months is an issue, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day data export and deletion certificate remain.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring post-termination transition assistance, machine-readable return of Customer Data within 30 days, and certified deletion.
